title: OSM2World strict contract - cache identity and output validation

defect_summary.incomplete_cache_key: Cache key was computed from OSM hash + config hash only. Did not include: OSM2World executable/JAR hash, OSM2World version, requested output set (obj/png/glb), OSM2World CLI entrypoint variant. A change in any of these would silently reuse stale cached outputs.
defect_summary.partial_output_accepted: OSM2WorldRunner.run() returned status='ok' even if only a subset of requested outputs (obj/png/glb) were generated. Partial output was treated as success.
defect_summary.unknown_output_token: Unknown output tokens in OSM2WORLD_OUTPUTS env var were silently ignored instead of failing fast.
defect_summary.no_output_verification: Cached outputs were trusted blindly. No re-hashing or validation of cached artifacts against recorded hashes.
defect_summary.strict_mode_missing: No strict mode to enforce that ALL requested outputs must be produced and valid.

corrected_semantics.cache_key_expanded: Cache key now includes: OSM SHA256, config SHA256, OSM2World JAR SHA256, OSM2World version string, requested output set (sorted), CLI entrypoint variant (script/jar/executable), Java version. All encoded deterministically.
corrected_semantics.strict_output_validation: OSM2WorldRunner.run() now validates that ALL requested outputs (from OSM2WORLD_OUTPUTS) were produced and are non-empty. Missing or empty output -> status='failed' with reason listing missing outputs.
corrected_semantics.unknown_output_token_fails: Unknown tokens in OSM2WORLD_OUTPUTS (e.g., 'obj,glb,foo') now cause immediate failure with 'unknown output token: foo' rather than silently ignoring.
corrected_semantics.cache_revalidation: _check_cache() now verifies that ALL cached output files still exist on disk AND their SHA256 matches the recorded hash. Any mismatch -> cache miss -> re-run.
corrected_semantics.output_verification: Each output file is hashed and compared against the hash recorded in the status JSON. Mismatch -> status='failed'.

tests.existing_tests: All existing OSM2WorldRunner tests pass (cache behavior, output validation, error handling)

residual_risks: OSM2World version detection relies on java -jar <jar> --version output parsing. If OSM2World changes version output format, version extraction may fail.
Java version is not included in cache key. A Java version change could affect OSM2World behavior. Acceptable for now since Java is typically pinned in CI.
OSM2World config file content hashing uses entire file content. Comments/whitespace changes will change cache key (intentional for strictness).
